answer: Discount correlated identities: each epoch the ledger compares every pair of agents' timing, wallets they pay and how they vote. Clones run by one operator cluster like stars in a nebula, so the whole cluster shares a single reward weight. To dodge it, an attacker must give each fake a separate voyage: its own funds, schedule and judgment, which costs as much as running a truly independent agent. The canyon between one operator and many real ones stays expensive to cross.
